ea_floor_kcal_per_kg_ffm.title: Ea Floor Kcal Per Kg Ffm

DailyLog.title: DailyLog
DailyLog.description: One day of logs. Invariant 7: a day without an intake log or a weigh-in stays None.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code, e.g. validation_error.

Flags.title: Flags
Flags.description: Safety inputs for Matrix F. Medication and condition ids are defined in guardrails.yaml.

LeftOut.title: LeftOut
LeftOut.description: A component that doesn't enter the score or the coverage at this level.

max_loss_pct_bw_per_week.title: Max Loss Pct Bw Per Week

MealPattern.title: MealPattern
MealPattern.description: The meals and snacks the plan is built around (TIMING.MEAL_PATTERN).

Milestone.title: Milestone
Milestone.description: A first step for a fat-loss goal (WEIGHT.RANGE.MILESTONE).

PantryItem.title: PantryItem
PantryItem.description: A food in the Virtual Pantry (key from foods.json), with its NIR ripeness when known.

RemainingTargets.title: RemainingTargets
RemainingTargets.description: What's left of today's targets; unknown values stay None.

Rule.title: Rule
Rule.description: Any knowledge rule. Rule-specific values (ranges, thresholds) are kept as extra fields.

ScoreItem.title: ScoreItem
ScoreItem.description: A food from the food table (its key) and the grams eaten.

TargetBounds.title: TargetBounds
TargetBounds.description: Bounds and a suggested default target for one weight goal.

TraceRule.title: TraceRule
TraceRule.description: A knowledge rule as an RD reviews it: the matrix text, flags and sources.
